ABS Non-Conformity : Requirement: 
As per the ISM Clause 1.2.3.1, the safety management system should ensure compliance with mandatory rules and regulations.
Evidence: 
While reviewing the onboard International Load Line Certificate (Cert. No. 2311980, issued by LR on 10-SEP-2025), it was found that the recorded deck line position was indicated on the 2nd deck, but the on-site deck line was marked on the upper deck of the ship's side shells. 
Nature of NC: 
The deck line position recorded in the International Load Line Certificate was inconsistent with the on-site marked deck line on the ship's side shells (and was categorized as Nonconformity).

ABS Non-Conformity : Requirements: 
The SMS should ensure compliance with mandatory rules and regulations.
Evidence:
Review of Record of Hours of Rest of Seafarers (FM-0604-2) for the months of January 2026, December 2025 & November 2025, and found below crew's records were against the requirements of Reg. A2.3 of MLC 2006 as amended.
1. January of 2026
     - 3/O (Mr. Balonggay) on 11 & 14-Jan
     - AB (Mr. Li) on 14-Jan
     - AB (Mr. Daulat) on 11-Jan
     - AB (Mr. Dacanay) on 12 & 14-Jan
2. December of 2025
     - 2/O (Mr. Santonia) on 13-Dec
     - 3/O (Mr. Balonggay) on 12 & 25-Dec
3. November of 2025
    - 3/O (Mr. Balonggay) on 3 & 22-Nov
    - AB (Mr. Daulat) on 18-Nov
    - 2/E (MR. Gapasin) on 23-Nov
    - 2/E (Mr. Rabadon) on 23-Nov
    - 4/E (Mr. Budikey) on 23-Nov
    - FTR (Mr. Dimabalot) on 23-Nov
    - MM (Mr. Dimabalot) on 23-Nov
    - JMM (Mr. Elen) on 23-Nov
Nature: 
Above evidences were considered not in compliance with MLC requirements with Non-Conformity raised.

ABS Non-Conformity : Requirement: 
Per SE Manual, PR-0605, Section 5.1.2 Shipboard Safety Committee, the frequency of meetings should be held once per month and can be particular; a meeting should also be held after any serious incident or accident on the ship, if the normal meeting is not due within a week.
Evidence: 
AB's (Guo, Xiao-Bin) left index finger was injured (fracture) during the anchor operation on 13 April 2025. After medical care/ treatment ashore, the doctor diagnosed that the AB's discharge status was unfit for duty.
The earlier safety meeting was held on 31 March 2025 & the later safety meeting was held on 30 April 2025.
Nature of NC: 
Based on the evidence gathered, there was no documentary proof that an additional safety meeting was held within a week after the serious incident or accident, and it was categorized as Nonconformity.
